c.d: Bank_data_by_name

v8:item.v8:content: Returns banks available in the 1C database. Use when you need bank details such as bank name, BIC, correspondent account, or SWIFT code for document preparation or to check whether a bank exists in 1C. Returns only banks stored in 1C. Returns up to 100 records per call. To search for a specific bank, pass a plain substring in `filters.bank_name_contains`. Does not search the internet or external registries. All search filters must be passed inside the filters object, not at the top level of the input. Use filters.bank_name_contains/ Returns columns: bank_name ([str]): Bank name. correspondent_account ([str]): Correspondent account. bic ([str]): Bank BIC. swift_code ([str]): SWIFT code.

v8:item.v8:content: Returns non-zero inventory balances by product, warehouse, and organization. Use when you need to check how much stock is available for a specific product, warehouse, or organization. Returns product name, remaining quantity, warehouse name, and organization name. Returns up to 100 rows per call. Supports substring filters for product, warehouse, and organization names, and numeric quantity thresholds. Do not use it to get a list of products. All filters must be passed inside the filters object, not at the top level of the input. Use filters.product_name_contains, filters.organization_name_contains, filters.warehouse_name_contains, filters.quantity_less_than, and filters.quantity_greater_than. Returns columns: product_name ([str]): Product or nomenclature name. quantity_remaining ([str]): Remaining quantity. warehouse_name ([str]): Warehouse name. organization_name ([str]): Organization name.

Sales_Report

v8:item.v8:content: Returns sales totals grouped by product, warehouse, and organization. Use when you need quantity sold and sales amount for analysis, reporting, or sales verification. Returns product name, warehouse name, organization name, quantity sold, and amount sold. Does not return products with no sales in the selected reporting period. If `filters.date` is omitted, the server uses the current month. If the user requests sales for a month, send the date to the filter for the first day of the month. All filters must be passed inside the filters object, not at the top level of the input. Use filters.date. Returns columns: product_name ([str]): Product or nomenclature name. warehouse_name ([str]): Warehouse name. organization_name ([str]): Organization name. quantity ([str]): Quantity sold. amount ([str]): Total amount.
